mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points from the prior month signals improving labor market conditions, which reduces recession fears and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE declines by >0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signal a broad-based recovery in the real economy, which increases corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.1% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise > 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-recession recovery phase, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals a strengthening manufacturing sector, which boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO rises > 0.1% during a post-recession recovery phase.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above its 3-month moving average indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS is above its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals rising inflation expectations, which prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE declines > 0.2pp and PAYEMS rises > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE declines > 0.2pp and PAYEMS rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals an impending economic slowdown, which increases equity risk and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average during a late-cycle expansion.
